source_claims.claim: Within the supplied modelling lens, global reality and an actor's available knowledge are distinct.
Within the supplied modelling lens, an exception is bounded and does not replace the normal rule.
Within the supplied modelling lens, event reality, recorded reality and later interpretation must remain distinct.
Within the supplied modelling lens, common input does not guarantee common output because current state includes unique path history.
Within the supplied modelling lens, transferable guidance can be formed by compressing patterns from many lived or closed Sequences.

interpretations.interpretation: A multi-actor intelligence architecture should maintain Actor View separately from global/system state.
Rule exceptions require an explicit bounded contract containing authority, trigger, scope, alternatives, permitted action, consequence and closure.
Narrative memory should preserve separate records for event, observer/writer construction and later interpretation.
Prediction and decision systems should include actor-specific path history and current state rather than assuming identical response to identical input.
A reusable principle should be formed through comparison of closed cases, consequences, counter-cases and exceptions rather than promotion of a single anecdote.

supporting_sequences.name: Common Input with Unique Path History

wisdom_candidates.principle: Do not treat global/system knowledge as if every actor possesses it; reason from the actor's actual View when modelling that actor.
applies_when: multiple actors or systems have different information access
does_not_apply_when: the contract intentionally models only global state and makes no actor-behaviour claim

wisdom_candidates.principle: An exception should be a bounded local contract, not a silent replacement of the normal rule.
applies_when: a claimed higher objective or conflict is present
does_not_apply_when: no authority exists to grant an exception
the claimed exception is actually a permanent rule change

wisdom_candidates.principle: Preserve event, record and later interpretation as separate provenance layers.
applies_when: knowledge reaches the system through testimony, narrative, history, scripture, commentary or later interpretation
does_not_apply_when: the source object is already explicitly defined as a single synthetic fixture with no external event claim

wisdom_candidates.principle: Identical external input need not produce identical response when relevant path history and current state differ.
applies_when: actor history or current state is causally relevant
the same stimulus reaches different actors or the same actor at different times
does_not_apply_when: the contract proves history/state are irrelevant to the tested transformation

wisdom_candidates.principle: Reusable guidance should be compressed from compared closed cases with consequences, exceptions and counter-cases, not promoted from one anecdote alone.
applies_when: the system is forming reusable guidance or a rule candidate from historical/case material
does_not_apply_when: the output is explicitly limited to describing one case rather than generalizing
